item.title: Jeremy Bowen: Trump is waging war based on instinct and it isn't working
item.summary: One month into the conflict in Iran, Trump's gut-instinct approach is not proving effective, writes the BBC's international editor.

item.title: Israeli police block Latin Patriarch from Palm Sunday mass in Jerusalem
item.summary: The move drew criticism from the church, global leaders and the US ambassador. Israel's PM said it was a safety measure following recent Iranian strikes.

item.title: Remove VAT from energy bills for three years, Tories urge
item.summary: There has been a renewed focus on energy costs since the outbreak of the war in Iran.

item.title: Iran says its forces 'waiting' as US troops arrive in region
item.summary: US officials have not confirmed if ground troops will be deployed in the conflict, which would escalate the war.

item.title: BBC reports from funerals of journalists killed in Israeli strike on Lebanon
item.summary: BBC reports from the funerals of three journalists killed by a targeted attack in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Iranian attacks across Gulf continue as major industrial sites hit
item.summary: A number of people are said to have been injured after attacks on aluminium sites in the UAE and Bahrain.

item.title: Iran-backed Houthis join war with attack against Israel
item.summary: There are fears the Iranian proxy may attack shipping in the Red Sea, adding to global economic woes.

item.title: Three Lebanese journalists killed in Israeli strike, say broadcasters
item.summary: The Israeli military confirms it killed Ali Shoeib from the Hezbollah-affiliated Al Manar TV.

item.title: 'My daughter is under the rubble': Inside Tehran as civilian toll of strikes rises
item.summary: One month since the US and Israel launched strikes on Iran, Tehran residents tell the BBC their lives have been devastated.

item.title: Tears and defiance as Lebanese family bury child, 11, killed in Israeli strike
item.summary: Jawad Younes and his uncle Ragheb were laid to rest on Saturday after their family compound was hit a day earlier.
